_comment: TDD M4 read slice: Gemini models.list first page renders each public route as a canonical Model resource (name/baseModelId/displayName/description/supportedGenerationMethods); unknown limits omitted never invented; nextPageToken is exact offset cursor. RED on baseline: Go has no Gemini list (404). Source: HEAD model_router/gemini.py model_resource+models_page.
name: m4_read_api_v1beta_models_page_canonical
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[[models]]
name = "m-b"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"

[[models]]
name = "m-c"
provider = "chatup"
